ignoredPathPolicy: Ignored and untracked paths, including retained local Android property files, are never ownership inputs and may not be used to satisfy a missing owner.
duplicatePolicy: ownedPaths are relative to their declared owner repository, and every tracked path beneath a mutable root matches exactly one owner-local domain. scanExactDuplicates is enabled for mutable implementation domains and disabled only for repository-support material where common fixture or documentation bytes do not constitute a second implementation. Empty blobs are package markers, not source duplication. Canonical component Gitlink mounts are repository boundaries, not generated copies. Identical non-empty tracked implementation source outside its owner is forbidden unless declared in generatedCopies with an exact owner-source digest; the decomposed composition declares no generated mutable copies.
